# RUNBOOK-LOCAL.md — {PROJECT_NAME}

> **Output file location:** `docs/dev-docs/RUNBOOK-LOCAL.md`.
> **Purpose:** how to run the project from zero to working. This is the first file
> a new agent or new developer opens — and the file most likely to be outdated.

**Rule:** every command here must actually work today. A wrong command is worse
than no command — agents will run it, fail, then try to "fix" the environment
in destructive ways.

---

## Prerequisites

| Tool | Version | How to check |
|---|---|---|
| {Node} | {≥ 20.x} | `node -v` |
| {pnpm} | {≥ 9} | `pnpm -v` |
| {Docker} | {≥ 24} | `docker -v` |
| {PostgreSQL client} | {≥ 15} | `psql --version` |

Versions are exact, not "latest". "Latest" changes weekly and breaks builds.

---

## Bootstrap (from clone to running)

```bash
{git clone {repo} && cd {project}}
{cp .env.example .env.local}          # then fill values, see table below
{pnpm install}
{docker compose up -d}                 # local database + redis
{pnpm db:migrate}
{pnpm db:seed}
{pnpm dev}
```

**Success when:** {http://localhost:3000} opens the login page, and
`{pnpm smoke:local}` exits with exit 0.

Reasonable time from zero: {± 8 minutes}. If much longer, something is wrong — do not
wait, check the Troubleshooting section.

---

## Environment variables

| Variable | Required? | Value for local | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| `{DATABASE_URL}` | Yes | `{postgresql://dev:dev@localhost:5432/{db}}` | docker compose |
| `{AUTH_SECRET}` | Yes | `{openssl rand -base64 32}` | generate yourself |
| `{VENDOR_API_KEY}` | No | leave empty | mock is used when empty |
| `{USE_MOCKS}` | Yes | `true` | always `true` locally |

> **Never use production credentials locally**, including "just to check quickly".
> If an integration has no sandbox, use a mock — see `docs/misc/INTEGRATIONS.md`.

---

## Seed accounts

| Role | Email | Password | Used to test |
|---|---|---|---|
| {admin} | `{[email]}` | `{dev12345}` | {full access} |
| {regular user} | `{[email]}` | `{dev12345}` | {authorization limits} |
| {other user} | `{[email]}` | `{dev12345}` | {data must not leak between users} |

Seed must be sufficient to run all `acceptance/*.feature` without manual setup.

---

## Daily commands

```bash
{pnpm dev}                 # dev server
{pnpm test:unit --watch}   # test while coding
{pnpm db:reset}            # drop + migrate + seed — when local data is messed up
{pnpm db:studio}           # view DB contents
{pnpm mock:start}          # mock external vendors, if not automatic
{pnpm types:generate}      # regenerate types from contracts/openapi.yaml
```

Verification gates are in `VERIFY.md`, not repeated here.

| Port | Service | Conflicts with |
|---|---|---|
| {3000} | {app} | {other projects using Next} |
| {5432} | {Postgres} | {Postgres installed on host} |
| {6379} | {Redis} | — |
| {8080} | {mock server} | — |

---

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Most likely cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `{ECONNREFUSED 5432}` | docker not running | `docker compose up -d` |
| `{migration failed: relation exists}` | local DB state is stale | `pnpm db:reset` |
| `{API types mismatch}` | openapi.yaml changed | `pnpm types:generate` |
| `{tests pass locally, fail in CI}` | timezone or seed difference | run `TZ=UTC pnpm test` |
| `{vendor call hangs}` | `USE_MOCKS` not set | set `USE_MOCKS=true` in `.env.local` |

---

## Full reset (when you can no longer tell what is broken)

```bash
{docker compose down -v}
{rm -rf node_modules .next}
{pnpm install}
{docker compose up -d && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed}
```
